caption: Fake payment instructions are one of the most common property scams. One phone call stops it.

scenes.sub: This email could cost you the deposit.
scenes.say: Buying property? This email could cost you the deposit.

scenes.title: “Updated” bank details
scenes.body: Sent right before closing, looking like your agent.
scenes.say: Scammers send updated bank details right before closing, made to look like your agent.

scenes.title: Call a number you already have
scenes.body: Confirm the account out loud before you pay.
scenes.say: Before you pay, call your agent on a number you already have, and confirm the account out loud.
Verify by phone. Every time.

caption: Text-message codes are better than nothing. An authenticator app or passkey is much harder to steal.

scenes.text: Your 2FA codes by text can be stolen.
scenes.say: Your login codes by text can be stolen. Do this instead.

scenes.title: SIM swap
scenes.body: A scammer moves your number to their SIM and gets your codes.
scenes.say: In a SIM swap, a scammer moves your number to their SIM, and your codes go to them.

scenes.title: Authenticator app or passkey
scenes.body: Codes stay on your device, not your number.
scenes.say: Use an authenticator app or a passkey instead. The codes stay on your device.

scenes.title: Keys kept offline
scenes.body: Built for long-term storage.
scenes.say: A cold wallet keeps your keys offline. It's built for long-term storage.
Know where your keys live.

caption: Fake sellers are a real risk in property deals. Verify ownership before you pay anything.

scenes.text: Before you pay for land or a house…

Verify first. Pay second.
